acceptance_criteria: The hole-filler request disables the reasoning trace via ReasoningEffort::None
A longer probe that previously failed now fills successfully against the live reasoning model
The budget stays large enough for output, so the two mitigations are independent
task.description: JN-7 raised the fill budget from 1024 to 8192 and its short probe then succeeded, but a longer prompt fails the same way: the live run against cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 with max_tokens 8192 still returned empty response content, and sawhorse diagnostic names the cause again - the thinking trace consumed the budget before any content. Raising a number is a mitigation whose headroom depends on prompt size. The contract already models the real fix: ReasoningEffort::None makes the payload send thinking disabled plus reasoning_effort none, and a deterministic code filler does not need a reasoning trace at all. Set it on the hole-filler request, keep the larger budget as headroom for output, and assert both in the unit test.
task.title: Hole filling should disable the reasoning trace, not just raise the token budget

receipt.summary: ReasoningEffort::None on the hole-filler request; joiner-core tests, clippy and fmt green; the probe that failed at max_tokens 8192 now fills in one attempt with a correct sliding-window implementation, outbox 20 to 22
